findings.evidence: cmd_approve is one of the three default-mode sites. For bound child C it can obtain DESIGN_VERDICT_HASH and DESIGN_SATISFIED_SOURCE_TID from governing task A at :6985, but it snapshots only the hash/observation. The later DESIGN-BINDING-TOKEN unconditionally calls latest_design_artifact_hash "$tid" and design_artifact_path_for "$tid", therefore reading C's own artifact source rather than A's. In the ordinary stable C->A case the durable approval carries design_verdict_hash=<A hash> while omitting design_hash and reporting 'no DESIGN-ARTIFACT record on C', despite A's artifact having just governed approval. More sharply, because the two reads are separated by the complete conflict/alignment/coherence ladder and no source snapshot or lock exists, a DESIGN-ARTIFACT recorded on C in that interval can make the final approval combine design_hash=<C hash> with design_verdict_hash=<A hash>. Section 10b asserts only approval status and exit code, so it cannot detect this record-level source split.

findings.evidence: The ownership condition closes the exact substitution path but does not establish the stronger invariant claimed at :12445-12462. If A and B each own a DESIGN-ARTIFACT, `design-unit-bind A --design-task B` passes because this invocation checks only B, and `design-unit-bind C --design-task A` passes because it checks only A; both writes succeed in either order and produce C->A->B. A->B may even be written before A owns an artifact because A is the source, not the checked target; recording A's artifact later then permits C->A. Conversely, a historical C->A written before this gate is not retroactively rejected. A's own record prevents fallback to B, so the specific verdict-laundering substitution is foreclosed, but the stated 'chain of length >1 can never be assembled' and 'write that would create a chain is refused' claims are false.
findings.description: Decide the actual invariant explicitly. If chained bindings are unsupported as the production comment says, reject a source or target that would form one and add both-order regression cases. If artifact-owning tasks may also be bound implementers, revise the two-level/no-chain claims and document the precedence semantics; the current gate guarantees non-substitution, not absence of chains.
